scope: Operational grid/method consistency for terrain comparison; not independent accuracy or mission suitability validation.
rationale: Engineering regression budgets to detect native-grid/encoding inconsistencies at the same analysis scale. These are project QA parameters, not calibrated scientific confidence bounds.
limitations: The 120 m and 240 m products share LOLA observations; they are not independent ground truth.
Passing this policy does not establish mineral, thermal, shelter or mission equivalence.
Terrain comparison remains limited to the stored physical window and analysis resolution.
